alternativeExplanations.title: Remember which pairs with which
steps: The pairings are easy to mix up because the names do not match the letters.
Secant goes with cosine, cosecant goes with sine, and cotangent goes with tangent.
A trick: look at the THIRD letter — se-C-ant pairs with cosine, co-S-ecant pairs with sine.
